# Aanandham Stays — Handpicked Highland Stays & Sanctuaries

> Official AI & LLM Knowledge Manifest for Aanandham Stays (Himachal Pradesh & Munnar, India)

Aanandham Stays is a boutique sub-brand of Aanandham providing personally verified, owner-operated highland sanctuaries, geodesic glamping domes, alpine dorms, and timber cottages across Parvati Valley in Himachal Pradesh and the misty tea ridges of Munnar, Kerala.

- **Website:** https://stays.aanandham.in
- **Operating Circuits:** Kalga Village / Kasol (Parvati Valley, Himachal Pradesh) | Suryanelli, Kolukkumalai & Vattavada (Munnar, Kerala)
- **Direct Concierge WhatsApp:** +91 90748 58014 | bookings@aanandham.in
- **Booking Mode:** Direct WhatsApp Mountain Desk & Inquiry Engine (Zero OTA commission, genuine direct tariffs)
- **Instagram:** @aanandham.go (https://instagram.com/aanandham.go)

## Curated Stays Portfolio (Himachal & Munnar)

### Himachal Pradesh Stays
1. **The Nest Kalga by Aanandham.Go (7,900 FT / 2,408m):**
   - Location: Kalga Village (above Barshaini Trail), Kasol, Parvati Valley, Kullu District, Himachal Pradesh (175105)
   - Coordinates: 31.9984° N, 77.4526° E
   - Stays: 10-bed Alpine Dorms (starts ₹249/bed), Deluxe Balcony Valley View Suites (₹1,499), Pine Mountain Suites (₹1,199)
   - Features: Panoramic east-facing sunrise deck, solar-powered basecamp, acoustic evening campfires, hot water geysers, Pahadi Siddu & Rajma dining, guided alpine ridge trails to Kheerganga and Tosh.
   - URL: https://stays.aanandham.in/camps/the-nest-kalga

### Guided Alpine Treks (Parvati Valley Basecamp)
1. **Kheerganga Trek (₹900/person):** 2 Days / 1 Night, starts from Kalga Village. Easy to Moderate. Includes trek guide, overnight accommodation, dinner and breakfast. Natural geothermal hot springs trail.
2. **Bhun Buni Thatch Trek (₹3,000/person):** 2 Days / 1 Night, starts from Kalga Village. Moderate. Includes trek guide, camping accommodation, tent, sleeping bag, dinner and breakfast. 360° snow peak alpine meadow ridge.
3. **Bhandak Thach Trek (₹3,999/person, proposed · provisional):** 2 Days / 1 Night, starts from Pulga village. Moderate to difficult. Includes trek guide, camping accommodation, tent, sleeping bag, dinner and breakfast. Ancient fairy forest & untouched virgin high pasture.

### Munnar, Kerala Stays
2. **Kolukkumalai Teddy's Campsite (7,100 FT / 2,164m):**
   - Location: Kolukkumalai / Suryanelli Ridge, Munnar, Idukki District, Kerala (685618)
   - Coordinates: 10.0261° N, 77.1420° E
   - Stays: Elevated sky deck & weather-insulated geodesic adventure domes (starts ₹2,299/camper)
   - Features: 4x4 rugged Jeep sunrise safari to Kolukkumalai summit above the clouds, campfire BBQ, clean en-suite washrooms, sunset ridge walks.
   - URL: https://stays.aanandham.in/camps/pkg-kolukkumalai-teddy-domes

3. **Suryanelli Valley Ridge Stay (6,070 FT / 1,850m):**
   - Location: Suryanelli Valley, Munnar, Idukki District, Kerala (685618)
   - Coordinates: 10.0150° N, 77.1350° E
   - Stays: Weatherproof high-altitude alpine ridge tents & pods (starts ₹1,899/camper)
   - Features: Cascading tea terrace views, live campfire BBQ, authentic Kerala dinner buffet, clean modern washrooms with hot water.
   - URL: https://stays.aanandham.in/camps/pkg-suryanelli

4. **Mini Mexico Vattavada Cabins (6,800 FT / 2,072m):**
   - Location: Step-Farm Valley, Vattavada, Munnar, Idukki District, Kerala (685615)
   - Coordinates: 10.1830° N, 77.2600° E
   - Stays: Handcrafted timber cottages & terraced wooden cabins (starts ₹1,900/camper)
   - Features: Organic strawberry terraced valley, pet-friendly private grounds, starlit campfire nights, homecooked highland meals.
   - URL: https://stays.aanandham.in/camps/pkg-mini-mexico

## Standard Hospitality & Stay Inclusions
- Direct host check-in and dedicated on-site caretakers
- Hot mountain meals included (Himachali Siddu & Pahadi specials in HP; Kerala buffet & Appam in Munnar)
- Evening campfire circles with live barbecue options
- Clean modern western washrooms with 24/7 running hot water
- 100% verified safe for solo female travellers, couples, and family groups
